attributes.CONSTRUCTION: Steel-pipe-pile, concrete-decked offshore wharf with two concrete-capped steel-pile breasting dolphins in line with face; and row of four concrete-capped steel- pile mooring dolphins 150 feet at rear of line of face, all connected by catwalks. attributes.REMARKS: One 20-, one 18-, and one 12-inch petroleum-product pipelines extend from wharf to eleven steel storage tanks at refinery in rear; total capacity 2,329,000 barrels. attributes.CONSTRUCTION: Concrete pile, concrete-decked offshore wharf with four concrete pile, concrete-decked breasting platforms in line with face; and four at rear of line of face, each connected by catwalk. A 35-foot-wide pipeline trestle extends along north side of approach, with pipelines supported by a 240+50- by 32-foot, undecked center portion of wharf. Wharf has an 1,800- by 20-foot  timber-and-steel-pile, asphalt-surfaced timber-decked approach.
attributes.MECHANICAL_HANDLING:
Two 1 1/4-ton, pneumatic mast-and-boom derricks with 
30- and 40-foot booms; and one 1 1/4-ton hydraulic crane with 45-foot boom for handling hose.  Two 16- and two 12-inch, swivel-jointed unloading arms.
attributes.REMARKS: Three 20-, four 16-, and one 10-inch petroleum-product pipelines extend from wharf to forty-five steel storage tanks at refinery in rear; total capacity 2,195,250 barrels. Tankage includes seven crude-oil storage tanks with total capacity for 1,404,000 barrels; and four bunker-fuel storage tanks with total capacity for 470,000 barrels. One 8 1/2-inch bunker-fuel line extends from storage tanks to wharf for supplying vessels with Bunker C fuel. Refinery connects to a petroleum-product pipeline extending from Seattle, WA; and to a crude-oil pipeline extending from Canada.
